Supports multiple interpolation methods via the `type` option: - `CurveType.CatmullRom` — interpolates through all points (default) - `CurveType.BSpline` — smooth approximation using de Boor's algorithm - `CurveType.Bezier` — composite cubic Bézier (4 points per segment) - `CurveType.Hermite` — cubic Hermite with tension-controlled tangents - `CurveType.Natural` — C² natural cubic spline Inherits directly from Path for single-entity GPU rendering with zero hierarchy overhead. Designed for fast per-frame updates — `setPoints()` uses raw numeric contours with zero string serialization.
